items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...that's the difference, say, between Wild Bill Davis and Jimmy Smith. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: And that is true. Say, for instance, you play your left hand, you have rhythmic patterns, and the tenor range and the alto range is one, and then the upper voices carry the melody, and then the accompaniment. And that is the basis of Jazz... Modern music, you know. Any kind of music.
Well, you can play like a band on a keyboard instrument. That's the difference, say, between Wild Bill Davis and Jimmy Smith.
